rules.logic: Anchors t0 on BIOC(MP-012 BYOVD Vulnerable Driver Load — wnbios.sys / WN_64.sys) and BIOC(MP-012 EDR Hook Removal via disabler.exe (EDRSandBlast Fork)) for one agent_hostname, then requires XQL(MP-012 Cobalt Strike Beacon to beamofthemoon.com C2 Infrastructure) and XQL(MP-012 rclone SFTP Bulk Exfil to 82.192.88.95) to bind to the same agent_hostname and causality actor within a 3600s window opened at t0. Fires ONE incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes and carries elapsed_seconds = first_exfil - tamper_t0 (from XQL(MP-012 Tamper-to-Exfil Elapsed Time (F6 MTTR KPI))) as the F6 time-to-contain KPI: the dwell an operator got between blinding the sensor and moving data. Time-to-contain passes when the stitched incident is raised before that exfil window closes.
rules.name: MP-012 EDR-Blinding Race — Tamper-to-Exfil Time-to-Contain Stitch
